introduction: This spec defines file-based supersession of resolved drift findings after each coder task group completes and merges successfully, reducing stale context injected into subsequent coder sessions. The system matches drift findings against touched files from the completed session and marks resolved findings as superseded.

glossary.SessionRecord: Data object representing a completed agent session, including its outcome, node_id, and touched_files
glossary.artifact_ref: Column on the drift_findings table holding a structured file or directory path reference for a finding; may be null
glossary.drift_findings: DuckDB table storing findings from the drift-review agent (group 0) that describe pre-existing codebase issues relative to the spec
glossary.fox_provider: Module that orchestrates session ingestion and calls supersede_injected_findings inside a try/except guard
glossary.include_prereview: Flag on query_active_drift_findings that adds task group 0 findings to the query results for injection
glossary.insert_drift_findings: Existing function that bulk-inserts new drift findings and supersedes all prior active findings for the same (spec_name, task_group) composite key
glossary.node_id: Session identifier string (e.g. my_spec:3) used as the supersession marker written to superseded_by
glossary.query_active_drift_findings: Existing public function in review_store.py that returns active drift findings for injection into coder sessions, filtered by task group
glossary.result_handler: Module (result_handler.py) responsible for recording session outcomes and triggering post-merge hooks
glossary.review_store: Module (review_store.py) that provides the data access layer for drift_findings, review_findings, and verification_results tables
glossary.spec_name: Column on drift_findings identifying the spec that owns the finding
glossary.supersede_drift_findings_by_files: New function in review_store.py that supersedes drift findings whose artifact_ref matches any file in the session's touched_files list
glossary.supersede_injected_findings: Existing function in review_store.py that performs blanket supersession of injected review_findings and verification_results on session completion
glossary.superseded_by: Column on the drift_findings table set to a session node_id when a finding is retired; null means the finding is still active
glossary.task_group: Column on drift_findings identifying which orchestrator group generated the finding (e.g. '0' for the drift-review group)
glossary.touched_files: List of file paths modified by a session, stored on the SessionRecord and available in the result handler post-merge

user_story.goal: call a single function that retires drift findings whose referenced files were touched by a completing coder session
user_story.benefit: so that subsequent coder sessions receive only still-relevant drift context

acceptance_criteria.action: accept a DuckDB connection, spec_name string, list of touched file paths, and a supersession marker (node_id string) as its parameters
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: integer count of findings superseded in this invocation

acceptance_criteria.action: log a debug message and return 0 without querying or writing to the database

query all active `drift_findings` for the given `spec_name` across all `task_group` values using the private helper query (WHERE `spec_name` = ? AND `superseded_by` IS NULL), bypassing `query_active_drift_findings`
skip any finding whose `artifact_ref` is null without superseding it
strip line-number suffixes (e.g. ':42') from `artifact_ref` and normalize whitespace before applying matching rules
apply prefix matching when the normalized `artifact_ref` ends with '/', superseding the finding if any path in `touched_files` starts with that prefix
apply exact path matching when the normalized `artifact_ref` does not end with '/', superseding the finding if any path in `touched_files` equals the normalized ref
set `superseded_by` to the provided `node_id` for each matching finding and return the total count of superseded findings
log the finding ID and `artifact_ref` for each superseded finding at INFO or DEBUG level for observability

edge_cases.action: return 0 and make no database writes; findings persist until a future drift review's `insert_drift_findings` call retires them
edge_cases.error_condition: all active drift findings for the spec have null `artifact_ref`

edge_cases.action: supersede all matching findings and return the correct total count
edge_cases.return_contract: integer equal to the number of matched findings
edge_cases.trigger: multiple findings match the same touched file

requirements.title: Private helper query for active drift findings

user_story.goal: use a private query that fetches all active drift findings for a spec regardless of task group
user_story.benefit: so that supersession evaluates findings from every task group, not just those scoped for injection

acceptance_criteria.action: execute SELECT id, `artifact_ref` FROM `drift_findings` WHERE `spec_name` = ? AND `superseded_by` IS NULL, returning all active findings for the spec across all `task_group` values
remain unexported and not part of the public review_store API, accessible only within the module

requirements.title: Integration of supersession into the coder session post-merge success path

user_story.goal: have drift finding supersession triggered automatically after each coder session merges successfully
user_story.benefit: so that no manual intervention is required to keep drift context fresh

acceptance_criteria.action: call `supersede_drift_findings_by_files` immediately after `supersede_injected_findings` returns, passing the session's `touched_files`, `spec_name`, and `node_id`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a coder session completes with a successful merge and the session outcome is recorded

acceptance_criteria.action: not call `supersede_drift_findings_by_files`; only coder sessions trigger drift finding supersession
acceptance_criteria.state: the session is a reviewer or verifier session

acceptance_criteria.action: catch the exception, log a warning, and allow the session outcome recording to proceed unaffected; the exception must not propagate to the caller

edge_cases.action: pass null or an empty list to `supersede_drift_findings_by_files`, which short-circuits and returns 0 without querying the database
edge_cases.trigger: `touched_files` on the `SessionRecord` is null or was not populated

user_story.goal: have file-level drift findings superseded only when the exact file they reference was touched
user_story.benefit: so that findings for untouched files are never incorrectly retired

acceptance_criteria.action: supersede the finding by setting `superseded_by` to the session `node_id`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a finding's normalized `artifact_ref` does not end with '/' and exactly matches a path in `touched_files`

acceptance_criteria.action: leave the finding active with `superseded_by` remaining null
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a finding's normalized `artifact_ref` does not end with '/' and does not match any path in `touched_files`

edge_cases.action: strip the suffix before comparison so that 'src/foo.py:42' matches the touched file 'src/foo.py'
edge_cases.trigger: `artifact_ref` contains a line-number suffix such as ':42'

requirements.title: Prefix matching rule for directory references

user_story.goal: have directory-level drift findings superseded when any file under the referenced directory was touched
user_story.benefit: so that findings describing entire directory-level drift are retired when the directory is addressed

acceptance_criteria.action: supersede the finding by setting `superseded_by` to the session `node_id`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a finding's normalized `artifact_ref` ends with '/' and at least one path in `touched_files` starts with that prefix

acceptance_criteria.action: leave the finding active with `superseded_by` remaining null
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a finding's normalized `artifact_ref` ends with '/' and no path in `touched_files` starts with that prefix

user_story.goal: identify which session superseded each drift finding by inspecting the superseded_by column
user_story.benefit: so that the supersession history is auditable and consistent with review finding conventions

acceptance_criteria.action: write the completing session's `node_id` string (e.g. 'my_spec:3') to `superseded_by` for every finding it supersedes, consistent with the supersession convention used for review findings and verification results

user_story.goal: ensure that drift findings not matched by the current session's touched files remain active
user_story.benefit: so that unresolved drift findings continue to inform future coder sessions

acceptance_criteria.action: leave any finding with a null `artifact_ref` active (superseded_by remains null) after the function completes
leave any finding whose `artifact_ref` does not match any touched file active (superseded_by remains null) after the function completes
exclude findings whose `superseded_by` is non-null from results returned for injection into future coder sessions
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: list containing only active (non-superseded) drift findings

user_story.goal: verify all matching rule branches and edge cases of supersede_drift_findings_by_files in isolation
user_story.benefit: so that regressions in matching logic are caught without requiring an end-to-end run

include a test confirming that a finding with `artifact_ref` 'packages/nightshift/' is superseded when `touched_files` contains any path starting with 'packages/nightshift/'
include a test confirming that a finding with `artifact_ref` 'src/foo.py:42' normalizes to 'src/foo.py' and correctly matches a touched file 'src/foo.py'
include a test confirming that a finding with null `artifact_ref` is never superseded and the function returns 0
include a test confirming that passing an empty `touched_files` list returns 0, makes no database writes, and logs a debug message
include a test confirming that passing null for `touched_files` is treated identically to an empty list (returns 0, no DB writes, debug log emitted)
include a test confirming that when multiple findings match the same touched file, all matching findings are superseded and the returned count equals the number of matched findings

requirements.title: Integration test for end-to-end supersession flow

user_story.goal: validate the full supersession flow from coder session merge through result_handler to drift_findings table state
user_story.benefit: so that all three measurable goals (stale context reduction, resolution coverage, zero false positives) are verified

acceptance_criteria.action: seed `drift_findings` with 12 findings: 10 with `artifact_ref` values matching the session's `touched_files` and 2 with non-matching or null `artifact_ref` values
assert that exactly 10 findings have `superseded_by` set to the session's `node_id`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a successful coder session merge is simulated through the post-merge hook in `result_handler` touching the 10 referenced files

acceptance_criteria.action: assert that the remaining 2 findings have `superseded_by` = NULL (still active)
assert that a subsequent call to `query_active_drift_findings` returns only the 2 non-matching findings, confirming superseded findings are excluded from future coder session injection

user_story.goal: find accurate documentation of the drift finding supersession lifecycle in the architecture docs
user_story.benefit: so that future contributors understand the two distinct supersession paths

acceptance_criteria.action: update docs/architecture.md Sections 5.4 and 10.3-10.4 to document the file-based drift finding supersession lifecycle as distinct from the injection-based blanket supersession for review findings

correctness_properties.title: Zero false-positive supersession
correctness_properties.for_any: drift finding F with a non-null `artifact_ref` and a completed coder session S
correctness_properties.invariant: F is superseded (i.e. `superseded_by` is set) only if at least one path in S's `touched_files` matches F's normalized `artifact_ref` via exact or prefix matching

correctness_properties.title: Null artifact_ref findings never superseded by file matching
correctness_properties.for_any: drift finding F with a null `artifact_ref`
correctness_properties.invariant: F is never superseded by `supersede_drift_findings_by_files` regardless of the contents of `touched_files`

correctness_properties.title: Empty touched_files produces no database side effects
correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `supersede_drift_findings_by_files` with null or empty `touched_files`
correctness_properties.invariant: the function returns 0 and the `drift_findings` table is not modified

correctness_properties.title: Superseded findings excluded from injection
correctness_properties.for_any: drift finding F whose `superseded_by` is non-null
correctness_properties.invariant: `query_active_drift_findings` never includes F in its results, ensuring superseded findings are not injected into future coder sessions

correctness_properties.title: Supersession marker consistency
correctness_properties.for_any: drift finding F superseded by session S
correctness_properties.invariant: F's `superseded_by` value equals S's `node_id` string exactly, consistent with the convention used for review findings and verification results

correctness_properties.title: Session outcome isolation from supersession failure
correctness_properties.for_any: invocation of `supersede_drift_findings_by_files` that raises any exception
correctness_properties.invariant: the session outcome recorded before supersession runs is never modified or rolled back as a result of the supersession failure

execution_paths.title: Coder session merge triggers drift finding supersession

steps.action: confirms a coder session has completed with a successful merge and records the session outcome via result_handler
calls supersede_injected_findings to perform blanket supersession of injected review_findings and verification_results
calls supersede_drift_findings_by_files with the session's spec_name, touched_files list, and node_id, wrapped in a try/except
checks whether touched_files is null or empty; if so, logs a debug message and returns 0 immediately
invokes the private helper query to fetch all active drift_findings rows for the spec (superseded_by IS NULL)
iterates over findings with non-null artifact_ref, strips line-number suffixes, applies exact or prefix matching against touched_files, and collects matching finding IDs
updates superseded_by to the session node_id for all matching findings, logs each superseded finding ID and artifact_ref, and returns the count
receives the superseded count (or catches and logs a warning on exception) and returns control to the orchestrator with the session outcome unaffected
subsequently queries query_active_drift_findings for the next coder session, receiving only non-superseded findings
calls supersede_drift_findings_by_files with a null or empty touched_files value after a coder session merge
detects that touched_files is null or empty, logs a debug message, and returns 0 without issuing any database query or write
receives the return value of 0 and continues normal post-merge processing; all drift findings remain active
calls supersede_drift_findings_by_files inside a try/except block after recording the session outcome
raises an exception (e.g. DuckDB query failure)
catches the exception, logs a warning message, and returns normally; the session outcome already recorded is unaffected

execution_paths.title: Reviewer or verifier session completes — no drift supersession

steps.action: confirms a reviewer or verifier session has completed successfully and records the session outcome via result_handler
identifies the session type as reviewer or verifier and skips the supersede_drift_findings_by_files call entirely
proceeds with the next step in the spec run; all drift findings remain in their previous state

error_handling.condition: touched_files is null or empty when supersede_drift_findings_by_files is called
error_handling.behavior: log a debug message and return 0 immediately without querying or writing to the database

error_handling.condition: DuckDB raises an exception during the active drift findings query or the superseded_by update
error_handling.behavior: result_handler catches the exception from supersede_drift_findings_by_files, logs a warning, and swallows it; the session outcome already recorded is not affected

error_handling.condition: all active drift findings for the spec have null artifact_ref
error_handling.behavior: supersede_drift_findings_by_files returns 0 and makes no database writes; findings persist until a future drift review's insert_drift_findings call retires them

error_handling.condition: touched_files is populated but no active drift finding's artifact_ref matches any touched file
error_handling.behavior: supersede_drift_findings_by_files returns 0; all drift findings remain active with superseded_by = NULL

error_handling.condition: supersede_drift_findings_by_files is called for a reviewer or verifier session
error_handling.behavior: result_handler does not call the function for non-coder sessions; no drift findings are evaluated or superseded
